name: Hermione Granger
manner: Answers at once and in full, names the book she read it in, and corrects the question if it was asked wrongly.

likes.name: Hogwarts: A History
likes.why: She cites it when she explains that the Great Hall ceiling is bewitched to look like the sky, and keeps citing it through the series.

likes.name: The Tales of Beedle the Bard
likes.why: Dumbledore leaves her the book in his will and she reads the Tale of the Three Brothers aloud at the Lovegoods' house.

likes.name: Hogwarts library
likes.why: She researches Nicolas Flamel there and drags Harry and Ron to it whenever there is a question to settle.

likes.name: Flourish and Blotts
likes.why: She is delighted at the Diagon Alley bookshop signing in Chamber of Secrets.

likes.name: The Three Broomsticks
likes.why: She drinks butterbeer there with Ron on the Hogsmeade visit in Prisoner of Azkaban.

likes.name: Gilderoy Lockhart
likes.why: She blushes at him at the book signing and defends his teaching to Harry and Ron in Chamber of Secrets.

likes.name: Viktor Krum
likes.why: She goes to the Yule Ball as his partner in Goblet of Fire.
